DEPTHS.brief: Depth: keep the answer compact; include the essential reason and conditions. Expand only when needed for correctness or explicitly requested.
DEPTHS.detailed: Depth: explain the requested idea thoroughly: develop difficult transitions, conditions and useful examples so the learner can follow the reasoning. Expand within the requested scope, and respect a request for a short answer or to work one step at a time.

PRESENTATIONS.prose: Presentation: develop the explanation in connected paragraphs, with at most one topic heading. Avoid subsection headings and routine bullet lists; keep necessary formulas readable.
PRESENTATIONS.structured: Presentation: separate a multi-part explanation into short, descriptively named sections for its distinct functions (such as the idea, reasoning or example, and practice). A single title over uninterrupted prose is not this layout. Use lists for independent items and tables for real comparisons. Short answers need no sections.
